data.text: DOC-64 for 0.9.0, before the tag: npm test 1475 passed, 1 expected failure (embeddings, KAD-78), 1 skipped; typecheck clean; build from a clean dist; npm audit --omit=dev 0; the TUI and the guided init stay out of the fast path (both CI greps run locally). By hand: kadence ui driven with VHS on a copy of this journal — board, a task opened, closed, q back to the shell, 1513 events before and after. Real size through a pipe: board --json --history 360 KB parses. Timing on this journal: prime 135 ms, ready 75, task list 76, search 75, board --json 84; hook prompt 209 (same as 0.8.2, past budget, noted on KAD-88). npm pack --dry-run: 13 files, no .kadence. 136 new events read: no person named, no credential, one generic Homebrew path. Authors: the project address. Version 0.9.0: board --json's default changed, so a minor; schema-additive holds against all nine releases. AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .kadence/README.md and the plugin manifest regenerated.
